title: Pan-Seared Norwegian Apple Puff
description: A simple dessert recipe that combines the crunch of puff pastry with the sweetness of Norwegian apples. This treat is perfect for snacking or as a light dessert.
instructions: 1. Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. Roll out the puff pastry on a lightly floured surface to a 12x16-inch rectangle.
3. In a small bowl, mix together the sliced apples, granulated sugar, and cinnamon.
4. Arrange the apple mixture in the center of the puff pastry, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
5. Brush the edges of the pastry with the melted butter.
6. Fold the 1-inch border over the apples to seal the pastry, pressing gently to adhere.
7. Brush the top of the pastry with the beaten egg for a golden glaze.
8. Use a sharp knife to create a decorative edge around the pastry.
9. Place the pastry on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
10. Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
